name: Professional User Auth System (Signup, Login, Forgot Password)

parameters.query:
WITH target_user AS ( SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $('Auth API Endpoint1').item.json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' ) SELECT id, full_name, email, password_hash, auth_provider, verification_code, code_expires_at, is_verified, true AS "emailExists" FROM target_user UNION ALL 
SELECT NULL::uuid AS id, NULL::text AS full_name, 'none'::text AS email, NULL::text AS password_hash, NULL::text AS auth_provider, NULL::text AS verification_code, NULL::timestamptz AS code_expires_at, false::boolean AS is_verified, false AS "emailExists" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_user);
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $('Auth API Endpoint1').item.json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' ) AS "emailExists";

parameters.subject: Password Reset Request
parameters.html:
= Password Reset Request

Password Reset Request

We received a request to reset the password for your account. Use the secure single-use code below to authorize this change:

{{$('Generate Recovery Token1').item.json.resetToken}}

⏱️ This security code is strictly valid for **15 minutes**. If you did not make this request, another person likely typed your email address by mistake. Your account remains safe, and no changes have been applied.

🛡️ Anti-Fraud Reminder: Never share this security code with anyone. Our support engineering staff will never contact you to ask for this token.

parameters.subject: OTP-verification for STEM
parameters.html:
= Account Verification

Verify your email address

Thank you for signing up. Please use the single-use security code below to complete your account verification.

{{$('password and OTP generator').item.json.otpCode}}

⏱️ This verification code is valid for 15 minutes. If you did not request this code, you can safely ignore this email.

🔒 Security Alert: Our team will never contact you directly to ask for this code. Keep it completely confidential.

INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, full_name, auth_provider, verification_code, code_expires_at, is_verified) 
VALUES (
  '{{$('Auth API Endpoint1').item.json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim()}}', 
  '{{$json.hashedPassword}}', 
  '{{$('Auth API Endpoint1').item.json.body.fullName}}', 
  'credentials',
  '{{$json.otpCode}}',
  '{{$json.expiresAt}}',
  false
);
UPDATE users SET is_verified = true, verification_code = NULL, code_expires_at = NULL WHERE email = '{{ $('OTP-receiver').item.json.body.email }}' RETURNING id;

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' ) AS email_exists, COALESCE((SELECT is_verified FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}'), false ) AS is_verified;

UPDATE users SET full_name = '{{ $('Auth API Endpoint1').item.json.body.fullName }}',
    password_hash = '{{ $('password and OTP generator').item.json.hashedPassword }}',
    verification_code = '{{ $('password and OTP generator').item.json.otpCode }}',
    code_expires_at = '{{ $('password and OTP generator').item.json.expiresAt }}'
WHERE email = '{{ $('Auth API Endpoint1').item.json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}'
AND is_verified = false
RETURNING id;

UPDATE users SET verification_code = '{{ $json.resetToken }}', code_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '15 minutes' WHERE email = '{{ $node["Auth API Endpoint1"].json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' RETURNING id;
SELECT verification_code, code_expires_at FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}';

UPDATE users SET password_hash = '{{ $json.hashedPassword }}', verification_code = NULL, code_expires_at = NULL WHERE email = '{{ $('Webhook2').item.json.body.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' RETURNING id;

UPDATE users SET full_name = '{{ $json.name }}',
    email = '{{ $json.email }}',
    is_verified = {{ $json.email_verified }},
    auth_provider = 'google',
    password_hash = NULL,
    verification_code = NULL,
    code_expires_at = NULL
WHERE email = '{{ $json.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}'
AND is_verified = false
RETURNING id;

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $json.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' ) AS email_exists, ( SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $json.email.toLowerCase().trim() }}' LIMIT 1 ) AS id;
